dialogues.speaker: Izem
dialogues.text: It's not bad. Or as what the people here might say, it's pretty good.

dialogues.speaker: Izem
dialogues.text: Everyone loves peace and quiet. Although I'm not really used to it, there's nothing to complain about.

dialogues.speaker: Izem
dialogues.text: Drinking coffee every day, lazing about, passing each day slowly... I feel like my days are longer than when I was in the Corps of Thirty.

dialogues.speaker: Izem
dialogues.text: The acting manager makes me the same coffee every day, and says I should be as used to peace as the nearby residents are.

dialogues.speaker: Izem
dialogues.text: A day like that will probably come in the future.
